caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cross placed vertically and partially embedded in a short, rounded tree stump or log. The cross is painted in various shades of blue and gray, with both the horizontal and vertical beams having jagged, sawtooth-like ends. The vertical piece is longer than the horizontal piece and has a white cross symbol painted near the top. Handwritten text in black cursive handwriting appears on the front of the cross, with the name "Arturo Andres Flores" prominently centered on the horizontal arm. The rest of the inscription details the dates of birth (1838) and death (1911), as well as additional words in Spanish including “En Memoria de” and “murió en 1911 nacido en 1838.” The composition is simple, with the cross and stump occupying the center of an otherwise empty, light beige background. At the bottom right of the cross, the name "Mabel G. Chapman - Taos - NM" is handwritten.
title: Hand Made & Painted Wooden Cross - Headstone
